name: XGR MCP Gateway
tagline: Open-source MCP gateway for XGRChain data and auditable XDaLa workflows.
description: XGR MCP Gateway connects compatible AI agents to the public XGRChain network and XDaLa process infrastructure. It exposes blockchain and Explorer data, process information, workflow tools and structured preparation of on-chain actions through Model Context Protocol. The public hosted endpoint uses Streamable HTTP at https://mcp.xgr.network/mcp. Users retain control of wallet signing. Source code: https://github.com/xgr-network/xgr-mcp.
